# ractermx_domain_notification_preference (Resource)

Manages per-domain notification preferences in RacterMX.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure notification preferences for a domain.
resource "ractermx_domain_notification_preference" "example" {
  domain_id    = ractermx_domain.example.id
  muted        = false
  min_priority = "high"
}

resource "ractermx_domain" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) The numeric ID of the domain. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `min_priority` (String) The minimum priority threshold for notifications.
- `muted` (Boolean) Whether notifications are muted for this domain.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import notification preferences using the domain numeric ID.
terraform import ractermx_domain_notification_preference.example 123
```
